image_generation.title: Generate Image
image_generation.prompt_tooltip: The main text prompt to guide the image generation.
image_generation.negative_prompt_tooltip: Text prompt to guide the image generation away from specified concepts.
image_generation.model_tooltip: Select the image generation model to use, and whether to use a refiner model to enhance the generated image quality (only available for SDXL).
image_generation.steps_tooltip: Number of diffusion steps. Higher values generally lead to better quality but take longer.
image_generation.images_tooltip: Number of images to generate per prompt. Limited to 1 for image-to-image.
image_generation.set_image_tooltip: Upload an image to use as a base for image-to-image generation.
image_generation.guidance_scale_tooltip: Controls how strongly the image generation adheres to the prompt. Higher values mean more adherence.
image_generation.denoising_tooltip: Controls the amount of noise added to the input image. Higher values mean more creativity but less resemblance to the original.
image_generation.strength_tooltip: Controls how much the generated image resembles the input image. Only for image-to-image.
